reasoning_traces.think:
The core challenge is bridging sequential event data (MLB tracking) to probabilistic decision-making. Textual serialization maps physical trajectories into Markov chains of discrete states. Continuous pretraining adapts a generic language model to sport grammar, yielding state-transition kernels. However, fixed windows break temporal coherence, introducing systematic bias. To mitigate this, we require explicit calibration: the model's softmax logits must align with empirical frequencies. This ensures that when the model predicts a 70% chance of a home run, it genuinely hits 70% of the time across independent samples. Without this property, the world model becomes a black box oracle, unsuitable for GSE's situational reasoning pipeline, which relies on well-defined uncertainty quantiles.
